title: Pentacoccous
summary: PEN'TACOCCOUS, adjective [Gr. five, and Latin coccus, a berry.] Having or containing five grains or seeds, or having five cells with one seed in each.

inlines.v: PEN'TACOCCOUS, adjective [Gr. five, and Latin coccus, a berry.] Having or containing five grains or seeds, or having five cells with one seed in each.
